storyboard.ears: Americans send far less mail, yet stamps cost more.
USPS mail fell to 109 billion pieces, leaving the network with nearly half its peak traffic.

storyboard.ears: First-Class Mail fell to 46 billion pieces, showing letters led the collapse.
